Topic 4.3: Language Use 4.3.1 Subject- verb agreement – verb ‘do’
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language Use 4.3.1 Subject- verb agreement – verb ‘do’, part of Strand 4 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we write correct sentences?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
